plugins.name: writing
plugins.description: Publication-prep tools for academic / public-facing writing. Bundles style (17 canonical English-prose rules + 18 page-cap additions + 2 audit-time rules), plot (matplotlib templates for paper figures), review (pre-submission self-review of own AI/ML paper Overleaf draft), paper-overleaf (opus subagent for Overleaf-synced LaTeX paper editing), and the anti-autoresearch integrity-forensics suite (12 skills: /anti-autoresearch orchestrator + evidence-ledger, consistency-audit, citation-forensics, baseline-comparison-audit, experiment-forensics, eval-design-forensics, proof-derivation-forensics, presentation-signals, ai-style-impressions, adversarial-case-builder, novelty-duplication-advisory; vendored from wanshuiyin/Anti-Autoresearch, MIT, support files under anti-autoresearch/).

plugins.name: kexue-fm
plugins.description: 科学空间 kexue.fm（苏剑林博客）全站离线库：一个 SQLite（全文 Markdown、LaTeX 原样、标签、官方引用格式）+ 一个 kexue skill（多路检索 search、读全文 show、增量 sync）。
